title: Impact of Topology on Multipartite Entanglement Distribution Protocols in Quantum Networks
summary: Quantum networks will rely on entanglement distribution to enable multi-user applications such as distributed quantum computing and cryptography. While multipartite entanglement distribution routing protocols have been extensively studied on idealised grid topologies, less is understood about how real network structure shapes their performance and resource requirements.
